Definition: Ladan, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ladan — Laadan in the King James Version — is the name of two Israelites, both Levites of the Gershonites. In 1 Chronicles 7:26 he is in the line of Ephraim, and in 1 Chronicles 23:7 and 1 Chronicles 23:8 he is the Gershonite whose sons Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel were chiefs of their fathers' houses.
TheologicalSignificance: To my mind, the two Ladans show how the Levites kept their lines: the same name in two families, both serving the house of the Lord, and both written down.
